own_full_chain_observation: Native source wiring is concrete: PerkTypeHandler registers KEY_CHEATDEATH constructor; PerkTreeLoader selects registered perk_class, deserializes data and builds Loaded/Prepared tree; server setup replaces tree by invalidating old concrete perks then validating new. AbstractPerk.validate invokes KeyCheatDeath.attachListeners through CacheEventBus and invalidate unregisters all cached listeners plus this CooldownPerk key. RegistryEffects independently creates/names/registers cheat_death and attaches its LOW death listener. Current loaded perk-tree JSON/unlock availability is outside this source study.

HIGHEST producer only server PlayerEntity with current progress.hasPerkEffect(this), no active UUID/perk cooldown and successful actual shared charge drain. Presence of sealed application key denies regardless boolean payload. Producer writes cooldown before unchecked addPotionEffect timed token; it never cancels death or changes health. Defaults350charge/600cooldown/500effectduration/amp0 are declarations only, not installed values. No prior-token check, final refusal receipt or rollback. Existing token can therefore coexist with attempted payment; actual effect admission/merge is external.

Independent LOW consumer accepts any server LivingEntity holding active cheat_death, without checking player/perk/current charge/cooldown. It cancels first, removes the active token and immediately dereferences amplifier, then requests health min(max,4+2*amp), regeneration200amp2 and fireresistance500amp1. Returned effect admissions ignored. It grants no own explicit invulnerability timer, does not reset deathTime or clear all effects, and has no shown source/Boss/team/bypass exception. Matching Forge/MC cancellation, effect removal and final health/death rollback are not executed or expanded.

Cross-listener sequencing is the whole policy: paid producer can attempt a token before later final refusal; independently supplied token can be consumed even if producer cannot pay. If admission fails, no shown rollback of paid charge/cooldown. If intervening cancellation/default delivery skips LOW, an admitted token could remain for a later death or native expiry. These are conditional source boundaries, not demonstrated loss, bypass, exploit or guaranteed rescue. Event priorities alone are not separate credit.

After cancel/removal/health/effect requests, consumer scans alive other LivingEntity in victim AABB.grow3, independently setFire10 and applyKnockback2 with other-minus-victim coordinates. No sphere/LOS/ally/Boss gate or success acknowledgment; native vector/motion acceptance not inferred. Nearby control/fire is aftermath, not Boss immunity. Empty curative-item list only advertises no ordinary curative items, not universal unremovability. No explicit revoke/refund of token on perk seal/removal.

Cooldown owner is static separate SERVER and CLIENT TimeoutListContainer<UUID,ResourceLocation>; producer writes server route. setOrAddTimeout resets matching entry or adds; global SERVER END ticker predecrements every list and calls delegate before remove on<=0, then removes empty UUID lists. TickManager forwards matching END calls. This is remaining delivered tick state, not saved world timestamps/offline-playtime or wall clock. TimeoutList internal tick lacks own phase/type recheck; container/registrar gates supply it. Direct TimeoutList.removeIf is silent; container predicate-removal explicitly calls delegate first.

Timeout callback resolves current player by UUID/side and current perk by resource key; KeyCheatDeath.onCooldownTimeout is empty, so clearing/expiry does not issue a rescue/refund/ready cue or remove the effect token. removeAllCooldowns checks list exists before removing with callbacks; invalidate removes perk key across every UUID. Container direct removeList null-ret risks are not a demonstrated caller crash. Tree clear first calls clearCaches then invalidates; KeyCheatDeath uses empty inherited cache hook, actual cooldown deletion occurs via invalidate/helper.

Logout removes modifier sources but shown EventHandlerCache does not remove this UUID cooldown; server global ticking continues. Clone removes old/reapplies new perk sources then removes old-UUID cooldowns. Serverstop tree invalidation and helper.clear remove cooldowns; clientdisconnect clears own tree/helper. Ordinary source removal is not tree invalidation. None of these helpers clears the separate private charge map or ties token revocation/refund to cooldown removal. Native clone potion transfer and persistence are unexpanded, existing migration ownership unchanged.

Feedback does not certify refusal: dedicated PHOENIX_PROC packet/particles are commented TODO only; no revive sound in producer/consumer. Actual EffectCustomTexture18px inventory/HUD sprite draws expose active effect state, potentially granted/consumed in same event, not guaranteed visible rescue. Shared050 charge self-state packet is regeneration-only max/current, no token/event/reason/seq; source/activity packets qualify source changes, no explicit KeyCheatDeath cooldown or successful-refusal acknowledgment. Assets/native health-effect sync and actual transport/render remain unverified.

Whole policy differs from one-handler item sacrifice, persistent equipment active/rearm, immediate rescue with later immunity, charged-module window, external guardian life budget and deferred cancellation-before-payment queue. It also differs from Roots repeatedly replenished target-update token and Goety member-qualified wounded rearm: paid timed token producer and later independently qualified death consumer have separate charge/cooldown/token lifetimes. One whole source mechanism only; charge helper already050, shared timeout/loader/camera/network methods, constants, defects and lack of FX each0.

New spell server chooses duration (LONGER then SHORTER overrides), builds EntityTimeStop, sets player UUID/position/modifier reference, attempts spawn, sends start FX and optionally attempts player SPEED. spawn result ignored; cast returnstrue on either side, so wrapper sound and noncreative server cost/cooldown do not establish area insertion or any accepted target.
Actual parent is EntitySpellModifiable directly extending native Entity, not EntitySpellBase/EntityLifetimeBase. Constructor records instance, invisible/size and data-manager lifetime. onUpdate does not call native super; decrements own watched lifetime and setsDirty each delivered update, invokes onDeath and setDead at<=0. No side check in parent. EntityTimeStop.onDeath submits configured end sound. Child then continues its onUpdate without isDead/return gate: client smoke or server application still runs on terminal invocation.
Server child caches AABB on first update using current position/radius, then queries living targets each update. Box is not recomputed after later source movement or config change; not a follow-caster field. Excludes every EntityPlayer. Optional PEACEFUL consults friendly classification; FAMILIARS uses generic owned-familiar test, not recorded caster UUID. There is no EntityUtil.isBoss call here. Actual native potion applicability remains a separate unverified admission gate.
Each admitted-by-scan nonplayer sets static EntityTimeStop.refreshing=true, writes modifier core snapshot to target entityData, attempts addPotionEffect(time_stop,40), then resets static false. SLOW/WEAKNESS extended by40 and FIRE are attempted independently afterward. No result acknowledgment or rollback. Guards tolerate modifiersnull only for first two skip tests; later toArray/has dereference can fail. Flag is process-wide, not target/source keyed and has no finally; exception before reset can leave ittrue.
Exact041 native EventManager.onEntityTick: if target currently has time_stop, first removePotionEffect(time_stop), then event.setCanceled(true), and continues remaining handler branches. It does not set NoAI, velocity or updateBlocked. Thus source effect is a replenished consumable control token, not a40-update durable latch. No native LivingUpdate cancellation contract or event ordering executed; do not assert full physical freeze, exact per-tick coverage or absence of other listeners.
Concrete PotionTimeStop.removeAttributesModifiersFromEntity calls super and, unless shared refreshing flag istrue, attempts COLD_DAMAGE with configured cold_damage. It does not consult FREEZE modifier or saved snapshot, and ignores damage result. Consequently the explicit per-update remove outside the source refresh scope can invoke cold damage, not only natural final expiration. Source add/refresh callbacks within flagtrue suppress this branch if native engine invokes it there. Precise native remove-map/callback order and overlap/reentrancy not expanded.
Same native onDamage checks current time_stop on the victim and multiplies event amount by0.1, before other later effects. Whether the removal-triggered COLD_DAMAGE still sees the effect cannot be inferred without matching native potion-removal order; no asserted4 or0.4 final HP. FREEZE is registered/accepted by SpellTimeStop but unused in the shown entity/potion final damage gate; not a separate modifier implementation reference.
Ending source does not iterate targets or explicitly remove their current tokens. Any retained effect can be consumed by a later delivered target update (or other native removal); no orphan updateBlocked flag to sweep in this chain. Final source call may already sound/remove and still submit another token. Bonus slowness/weakness/fire has its own native lifetime, not an all-effects release at area death. Multiple sources overwrite same target snapshot and share one effect/refresh flag; no source-owned lease or reference counting.
Parent entity NBT writes playerId and modifier core array, reads ModifierSnapshot; it does not write/read watched lifetime.
